programs.title: Escape To The Country
programs.desc: Margherita Taylor is rural property shopping with a retired head teacher who has 400,000 pounds to invest in her leap to the country and has signed up her daughter to help her with the decision making.

programs.title: Bargain Hunt
programs.desc: Christina Trevanion is in Narberth, west Wales, where experts Philip Serrell and Kate Bliss help the teams find potentially profitable items to take to auction in Cardiff. Christina visits one of the oldest institutions in the world, the Royal Mint, to learn the history of how coins are made.

programs.title: Doc Martin
programs.desc: With Louisa visiting her mother in Spain to get some perspective on their marriage, Martin knows he needs to try to change for the sake of their relationship, so he endeavours to keep his promise to her to see a therapist. Aunt Ruth arranges an appointment for him with Dr Rachel Timoney, but a lifeboat training exercise causes problems for the doctor. Will he get back in time for his first session? Martin Clunes stars.

programs.title: A Touch Of Frost
programs.desc: Rendered homeless by his own carelessness after burning his house down, Inspector Frost takes on a nasty case of kidnapping. A 24-hour operation at the victim's flat leads to escalating demands from the kidnapper and even Frost finds it difficult to keep cool under the pressure. It proves a tough case for Frost to crack, and for the abducted woman, time is running out.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigations
programs.desc: When a two-billion-dollar Stealth Bomber crashes in Guam, it’s up to the US Air Force to investigate the most expensive aviation accident of all time.
